affected_component: tool_drafter._repair_source (+_rejection_code) retry message and final DraftError; draft_selfcheck.DraftSelfCheckRepairV1.diagnostics; product_jobs._apply_draft_control_repair rejection rows + previous_rejections; _self_check_repair_rounds
invariant: When Core refuses a model repair, the refusal's public code and field rows (loc/msg, never model output) travel three ways: into the retry prompt of the same repair call, into the final DraftError (message keeps the inner code after INVALID_MODEL_OUTPUT; diagnostics keep the rows), and into the round record (DraftSelfCheckRepairV1.diagnostics). The round loop hands every earlier refused attempt's rows, prefixed by its target, to the next repair as previous_rejections, so no repairer — same owner or the alternate — argues without knowing what was already refused and why.
